name: Ashtanga Shala Roma
reason: Too thin: its own site (ashtangashalaroma.com; robots.txt allows us) is Stefania Caito's one-teacher Mysore shala (via Veio, San Giovanni, Rome; SYC-authorised 2013) with a timetable page but no prices, booking by phone, and an events page whose latest item is an August 2024 workshop; the shala photos and talks pages date from 2019-2020 and the Saturday special classes include yoga therapy. Only the mantras and practice-advice pages would count as items. It does publish an email (stefaniacaito@gmail.com). Possible future listing: Stefania Caito.
